note: SCR-01G (Keen 4): a game. From the main card NEW GAME, BEGIN NORMAL GAME: the level box and the world map; Enter for the status window and a key to close it; F1 for the help menu and Escape back; Escape for the control panel in a game: SAVE GAME into the first slot, a name typed (K, E) and Enter, the Saving box; LOAD GAME's card with the saved game; RETURN TO GAME; the panel again (the game counts as unsaved), END GAME, its question, Y: the high scores. Menu keys 1.75 s apart (between two blinks of the cursor), the letters 72 tics apart (between two blinks of the line's cursor). The port's save is kept for scr_end and scr_load (screen_case.py port ... --keep, docs/notes/SCREEN_CASES.md). Times are seconds after the EGA mode set (KEYFEED.COM types the keys in DOS).
